description: This plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU scores and Average Lagging (AL) for four different machine translation models. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and uses a linear scale ranging from slightly below 0 to 8, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 2 (0, 2, 4, 6). The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and uses a linear scale ranging from 12 to 28, with numeric tick marks generally spaced at intervals of 2 (12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 28), featuring horizontal dashed grid lines across the plot area; a small grey rectangle obscures the area where the 26 tick mark would typically appear. The "Consistency-CE" line is represented by a light purple dashed line with circle markers. It shows an upward trend, starting at approximately x = -0.5, y = 13, passing through points such as x = 1.1, y = 19.8 and x = 3.8, y = 22.4, and ending at x = 7.3, y = 26.2. The "Inconsistency-CE" line is a purple dashed line with square markers. It also increases across the x-axis, beginning at x = 0.6, y = 20, rising through x = 3.8, y = 24.8, and concluding at x = 7.2, y = 27.4. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" line is a blue dashed line with square markers. It follows a similar upward trajectory, starting at x = 0.7, y = 19.7, intersecting the purple square line near x = 3.8, y = 24.8, and finishing at x = 7.4, y = 26.8. Finally, the "Consistency-Bi" line is a red solid line with star markers. It exhibits a steady increase from a starting point of x = -0.8, y = 22.6, passing through x = 3.3, y = 25.8, and reaching the highest final value on the plot at x = 7.4, y = 27.8.
